# Codex Trajectory v0.3.1

This release adds quota-aware live controls and an optional Codex in-app Browser shortcut, with additional hardening around every local bridge.

- See persisted Codex rate-limit windows in the live view and native picture-in-picture output, including remaining percentages and reset times.
- Request a safe stop for the current task, or arm an opt-in remaining-quota guard with a configurable threshold and at most one automatic request per displayed quota cycle.
- Keep worktrees and uncommitted changes intact: the standard Apps surface sends a model-mediated shutdown request, while the configured Browser path pauses an active Goal and interrupts only the exact bound App Server turn.
- Open the complete trajectory viewer from an experimental, off-by-default **View trajectory** shortcut next to `Full access`, without changing the composer or starting a model turn.
- Reuse the full safe-summary-first interface in a host-managed Codex Browser tab, including task selection, statistics, Token details, filters, pagination, live controls, and explicit full-detail confirmation.
- Follow Codex's effective System, Light, and Dark palette in already-open Browser tabs.
- Drive Browser Stop/Idle from App Server task state, rebind a rejected stale turn through a one-time full bootstrap, rearm manual controls for later turns, preserve the automatic quota-cycle latch, and retry transient automatic failures with bounded backoff.
- Ignore late state responses for a turn candidate that a concurrent Stop request already rejected as stale.
- Restrict the random-token injector to Codex-owned `app://` renderers, refuse linked process locks, reject non-interoperable local JSON, prevent CDP redirect following, and enforce absolute command deadlines.
- Return a bounded local API error when the CDP-backed Stop provider becomes unavailable.
- Try every eligible Codex renderer before reporting a bridge failure, and reject linked, multiply linked, non-regular, or oversized private settings and heartbeat files.
- Remove the injected Browser entry from the previous CDP endpoint when the configured port changes.
- Fall back to the same interactive in-page live panel when Chromium exposes picture-in-picture but rejects it at runtime.
- Resolve persistent `client-new-thread:*` sidebar keys to the materialized task UUID before enabling the shortcut, and show unknown point-only durations as `—` instead of `0 ms`.

After installing or upgrading, open a new Codex task so the updated plugin tools and Skill are loaded. The CDP shortcut remains disabled unless you explicitly enable it in the viewer.
